reason: A DeepSeek Harness gateway plugin that enables image-aware chat by sending user images to a configured vision-language endpoint, converting them to text, and routing the result through DeepSeek.

summaries.zh: 通过可配置的视觉语言模型将聊天中的图片转换为文字，并经由 DeepSeek Harness 的独立路由继续处理。
summaries.en: Converts chat images into text through a configurable vision-language model and routes the result through a dedicated DeepSeek Harness provider.

capabilities: Accepts image attachments from chat, screenshots, tool results, MCP results, and ACP clients
Sends image data to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible vision-language endpoint
Uses configured DeepSeek and vision-model API credentials
Converts image content into text before forwarding it to DeepSeek
Caches image descriptions in process memory using an LRU cache
Registers a DeepSeek vision provider route and plugin settings interface
